dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jreContainerMarker>
<!description: Replace the magic string literal for the JRE container problem marker with its symbolic constant.
This improves readability and maintainability.
>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!minJavaVersion: 8>
<!tags: eclipse, constant, magic-string>

"org.eclipse.jdt.launching.jreContainerMarker"
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.launching.JavaRuntime.JRE_CONTAINER_MARKER
;;
summary: Replaces the magic string literal "org.eclipse.jdt.launching.jreContainerMarker" with the symbolic constant JavaRuntime.JRE_CONTAINER_MARKER for improved maintainability and consistency.
